requirements.quote: Fact-pattern and statute searches need facets: statutes and sections, cited cases, subject area, court level and outcome.
`judgment_citation_ref`: judgment, raw citation, normalised citation, `cited_judgment_id` (nullable), page.
`judgment_tag`: judgment, subject area, confidence, model version.
**Statute refs:** reuse the #497 section parser (`match.ts`, `issues/` normalisers).

**Criminal-code mapping:** an offence-date-aware IPC↔BNS, CrPC↔BNSS and IEA↔BSA mapping table, built from the public BPR&D correspondence tables. It is a versioned data file with a source note, so a search for BNS 106 also finds IPC 304A and the reverse.

**Citation extraction:** neutral citations, SCC/AIR/SCR/MLJ/KLJ-style reporter citations parsed into normalised form, and resolution to corpus rows. Only the citation string is stored, never reporter page text.

**Subject areas:** a controlled vocabulary (medical negligence, consumer, rent control, motor accident claims, NDPS, bail, arbitration, IBC, service and so on) assigned through the gateway with schema-validated output.
**Outcome:** taken from the decision segment, with anchors (ADR 0028 style).
`packages/intelligence/src/corpus/enrich/`, with every output carrying a ruleset or model version:
`apps/worker`: a `corpus.enrich` job, re-runnable by version. Register it in the worker registry tests.
Update the #484 static editorial test (D-053): assert that every corpus source in the registry is official or open-licence, instead of banning column names.
On fixtures, statute refs are found with their page, and an IPC 304A judgment is retrievable by the BNS 106 facet. [type:unit]
Citation extraction precision is at least 0.95 and recall at least 0.9 on a labelled set; resolved citations link to existing rows. [type:integration]
Subject-tag macro-F1 is at least 0.8 on the 15 most common areas, reported. [type:integration]
Outcome is extracted with an anchor, or set to `unknown`. It is never guessed without an anchor. [type:unit]
Re-running with a new version replaces only that version's rows. [type:integration]
